- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast peak by 2–5% relative to sentiment strength.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes (sentiment < -0.5) — add 1–3% buffer to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoots after recent price spikes (especially >80) — apply 1–3 day lag correction: reduce forecast by 1–2% per day until price stabilizes.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen forecast by 1–3% for days 1–5 if sentiment is volatile or trending.
- If sentiment is flat or neutral (±0.2), reduce forecast volatility by 10–20% to avoid overfitting to noise.
